items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Did Case ever accompany Perry Como on recordings?

ctx.x: (HUMS A FEW BARS OF THE CAREY DANCERS)
Did you ever make...I don't know whether... Did Case ever accompany Perry Como on recordings? Maybe it's Mitch Ayres, I'm not too sure.
I think it was Mitch Ayres. I don't think Russ Case ever did that. He was sort of a stay-to-myself guy.
